prompt:
Create one polished game ability icon for a mechanical science-fiction roguelike, as a transparent PNG. Match the clean illustrated cel-rendering and confident contours of reference images 2 and 3, while using ONLY the palette specified below. Reference image 1 provides the subject and action, not the finish.
Art direction: a mature, elegantly simplified mechanical-comic illustration. Give the subject convincing volume and perspective using precisely designed surfaces and three clearly separated cel-shading regions. Smooth solid component colors. A clear dark outer contour, thinner functional inner seams, and tapered lines on effects; keep outlines substantial enough for 64px but never a thick sticker rim. Use restrained bevel highlights and large intentional shadow shapes. Light from upper left. One dominant focal point; secondary shapes guide the eye toward it.
Design the silhouette deliberately: bold tapering shapes, rhythmic curves, thoughtful negative space and an asymmetric yet balanced composition. The primary form carries about two thirds of the visual weight; the motion effect supports it. Fit the complete design inside a square with around 8% transparent padding. A concise icon with a handful of meaningful forms, not a miniature scene. Keep it legible at 64px. No texture, mottling, scratches, micro-detail, text, labels, watermark, decorative badge, frame, scenery, fake checkerboard or background glow plate.
Produce a single finished icon, not a grid. Real transparent alpha, no cast shadow on a background.
Subject and composition:
A decisive converging bombardment: three slim, sweeping projectile-energy paths curl from the upper left into ONE strong impact at lower right. The curves have different radii, lengths and widths, with a clear space between them. They are fast tapered strokes, not three identical solid bent tubes. Make the lower-right impact a compact three-dimensional jagged energy burst with a pale core and a deep purple outer silhouette, not a flat generic sticker star. Suggest a shallow impact crater using only a small broken elliptical rim and three angular rock fragments at its foot. The burst and converging motion form ONE compact visual emblem; no large ground platform. Keep the leading arc graceful, the other two subordinate, and the energy direction unambiguous.
Project palette and area hierarchy:
Dominant dark and middle violet: #2A104B and #522C5C occupy most colored area. #835061 supplies controlled mauve lit surfaces; #E3B6B1 is a narrow bright track and burst transition, with a tiny #FEE4D9 impact core. Contour #150017. These are muted plum-purple colors, not electric magenta or fluorescent violet.
Final emphasis: refined mechanical design, economical linework, clean three-tone cel volume, strong focal hierarchy, smooth continuous surfaces.
